note: Machine-readable record of EVERY D1 table and column site/_worker.js writes, and the human-readable disclosure each one is covered by in site/privacy.html. scripts/ci/privacy_disclosure_gate.py fails CI if the worker writes anything absent from this file, so a new column cannot ship before the privacy notice names it. Adding an entry here is not the disclosure -- site/privacy.html must actually describe it.

database.purpose: Evaluate the pre-committed demand threshold in scripts/ci/demand_report.py, and bound abuse of the free estimator.
not_used_for: resale or disclosure to third parties
profiling or automated decision-making about a person

retention.disclosure: site/privacy.html states plainly that no automated deletion runs yet.

anon_ip_hash.salt_location: site/_worker.js (hardcoded constant in a public repository)
anon_ip_hash.reason: The salt is public and the IPv4 preimage space is 2^32, so the hash can be inverted by exhaustive search. It is a coarse de-duplication token, NOT an anonymising transform, and site/privacy.html must not imply otherwise.
anon_ip_hash.why_not_fixed_here: The static site deliberately has no secret surface; scripts/ci/cloudflare_pages_secret_check.py asserts this. Introducing one is an architecture decision, not a copy fix.

never_stored: checkpoint, scratch data, or proof bytes

columns.ip_hash: Salted, publicly reversible hash of CF-Connecting-IP. See identifier_limitations.
columns.window_start: Start of a one-hour window, unix seconds truncated to the hour.

tables.name: demand_log
tables.purpose: Shape-only record of accepted estimate requests, feeding the demand threshold.

columns.observed_at_hour: Unix seconds truncated to the top of the hour. Coarse, never precise.
columns.request_digest: Digest of the request shape, computed by the engine.
columns.field: Declared field name, e.g. goldilocks or babybear.
columns.trace_width_bucket: One of 8 fixed 32-wide bands; the exact width is not stored.
columns.logical_rows_bucket: One of 4 wide exponent bands; the exact row count is not stored.
columns.provable_today: Whether the declared config is inside the supported profile.
columns.blocking_reason_codes: JSON array of reason codes when it is not.
columns.key_id: Opaque random key identifier, when the caller presented a minted key.
columns.anon_ip_hash: Salted IP hash, when the caller did not. Exactly one of key_id / anon_ip_hash is populated.

tables.name: estimator_keys
tables.purpose: Free bearer keys that raise the rate ceiling and let a caller be counted as one distinct organisation.

columns.key_id: Independently-random opaque identifier, not derived from the key or its hash.
columns.key_hash: SHA-256 of the minted bearer key. The key itself is never stored.
columns.minted_at_hour: Unix seconds truncated to the top of the hour.
columns.revoked: Reserved flag; no revocation endpoint exists yet.

columns.window_start: Start of a one-hour window, unix seconds truncated to the hour.
